2. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
3. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

Lines are compared exactly; the first appearance is preserved in its original position.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Remove Duplicate Lines](/remove-duplicate-lines) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic.
